slide2: Deep in a hidden bamboo grove, where morning mist drifts between emerald stalks, a wise old Panda sits in perfect stillness, a white serpent coiled gently at his shoulder.
Here time moves slowly and the mind grows quiet. The Tiger meditates with paws pressed together, the Rabbit rests beneath a woven hat, and the Goat breathes with the swaying canes.
For centuries these gentle masters have guarded the secret of the grove: that true fortune is found not in haste, but in balance, patience and a calm and open heart.
When the golden koi stirs the waters and the lotus blooms with light, the bamboo reveals its hidden riches to those who approach with a peaceful spirit.
Breathe, let go, and let the harmony of Bamboonanza guide you to its greatest treasures.
BACKGROUND STORY
Expanding Grid
The grid expands by one row after each winning cascade.
Expansion continues up to a maximum of 8 rows.
Each expansion increases winning potential and feature impact.
CORE FEATURES
Multiplier Totem
The Multiplier Totem progresses through three stages.
Multiplier values increase as the Totem advances.
The active multiplier applies to all subsequent wins within the same game round.
The Multiplier Totem and active multiplier reset before the next game round begins.
slide3: The Mystery Symbol can land anywhere on the reels during both the Base Game and Free Games to reveal other symbols.
The Golden Bamboo Feature triggers when a Mystery Symbol reveals a Golden Bamboo Symbol.
During the feature, each Golden Bamboo position spins independently to reveal one of the following special symbols:
slide4: The Cash Symbol may appear during the Golden Bamboo Feature.
Available Cash Prize values are: 1×, 2×, 5×, 10×, 25×, 50×, 100×, 250×, 500×, 1,000×, 2,500×, and 5,000× the Base Bet.
When a Multiplier Symbol appears, all Cash Symbols and Collector Symbols currently on the reels are multiplied by its value.
The Multiplier Symbol is then removed from the reels. The vacated position spins to reveal a new prize.
The Collector Symbol may appear during the Golden Bamboo Feature.
When a Collector Symbol appears, it collects the values of all Cash Symbols and Collect symbols currently on the reels.
slide5: No low-paying symbol transform – Allows direct access to Free Games with 7–9 Free Spins and no low-paying symbol transformed at a cost of 100× the Base Bet.
2 low-paying symbols transform – Allows direct access to Free Games with 7–9 Free Spins and 2 low-paying symbols transformed at a cost of 180× the Base Bet.
4 low-paying symbols transform– Allows direct access to Free Games with 8–10 Free Spins and 4 low-paying symbols transformed at a cost of 600× the Base Bet.
RANDOM FREE GAMES – Randomly awards one of the three Free Games options at a cost of 300× the Base Bet.

slide2: A drifting spaceship has been overrun by mysterious Blobs created by a failed space experiment. As the Blobs spread through the ship, they connect, multiply, and trigger chain reactions within its systems. The further the invasion grows, the more unstable — and rewarding — the journey becomes.
BACKGROUND STORY
CORE FEATURES
Blob Symbols Jelly Symbols
Blob Symbols collect matching Jelly Symbols and all Feature Symbols. Jelly symbols can be upgraded up to Payout Level 7.
Chain Collect
The game features the Chain Collect mechanic, where Blob Symbols move across the grid and collect adjacent paying symbols in horizontal or vertical positions to form wins.

Blob Invasion is a 6×6 non-payline slot featuring the Chain Collect mechanic, an expanding grid, symbol upgrades and transformations, Wild Symbols, Golden Tile Symbols, and both a Bonus Game and an Ultimate Bonus Game, offering a maximum win of 10,000× the selected bet.
slide3: The Wild symbol substitutes for Jelly symbol at its corresponding current payout levels.
Three Bonus symbols collected by Blob symbols trigger Bonus Games.
slide4: There are nine different types of Feature Symbols in Blob Invasion:
Bonus symbols, Wild symbols, Golden tile symbols, Upgrade symbols, Upgrade All symbols, Transform symbols, Soapy Water symbols, Specimen Pod symbols and Flood Hatch symbols.
Golden tile symbols award a payout equal to their displayed value multiplied by the current active bet level.
The MAX WIN Tile awards the remaining amount required to reach the maximum win immediately.
slide5: Boost Bet – Activate to increase the chance of triggering the Bonus Games feature, at a cost of 3× the selected bet.
SOAPY WATER CHAOS – A single spin is played with the Soapy Water feature active from the start at a cost of 10× the selected bet.
MAXIMUM GRID SIZE – A single spin is played on the maximum grid size at a cost of 25× the selected bet.
BUY BONUS GAMES – Allows direct access to Bonus Games at a cost of 100× the selected bet.
ULTIMATE BONUS GAMES – Allows direct access to Ultimate Bonus Games at a cost of 500× the selected bet.

slide2: Decades ago, a shattered séance tore the veil between worlds.
What should have been sealed was left open, binding the restless dead to these halls and twisting the place into an endless night. Only Annie brings respite.
BACKGROUND STORY
CORE FEATURES
WICKED REEL
The Wicked Reel is positioned above the grid and consists of three rows.
The Wicked Reel contains Feature Symbols, blank symbols and empty cells. Blank symbols occupies positions only.
Feature symbols become active when they enter the grid.
Where she appears, the Specters withdraw—but never for long. They gather again in the shadows, fusing into something far worse.
The crackle of the PA system heralds new horrors. Ancient seals upon the doors glow with the promise of escape.
That promise is a lie.
Beyond each threshold lies only deeper darkness. Here, in the eternal seventh hour, awareness is the only light that remains. Let it fade, and the night will claim everything.
slide3: Wild symbols substitute for any paying symbol except Specters.
A winning combination consisting only of Wild symbols pays as the highest-paying regular symbol.
3 or more Bonus symbols appear anywhere on the grid will trigger Free Spins.
The Bonus symbol appears only in the Base Game.
slide4: Big Symbol – Activate a single game round with at least one Big Symbol guaranteed to enter the grid and the Wicked Reel, at a cost of 10× the selected bet.
Annie's Spell – Activate a single game round with Annie’s Spell guaranteed, at a cost of 50× the selected bet.
Buy Free Spins – Allows direct access to the Free Spins feature at a cost of 100× the selected bet.
Ultimate Free Spins – Allows direct access to the Ultimate Free Spins feature at a cost of 500× the selected bet.
During Ultimate Free Spins, the win multiplier starts at ×10.

slide2: Reward Multiplier symbols land only on the special reel 4 and boost that spin’s line win.
Payout = number-symbol combination × Reward Multiplier.
Special Symbol — Reward Multiplier (2× / 5× / 10×)
Scatter

The reel 4 features activate progressively with the player’s stake. While a feature is locked, its position on reel 4 displays a padlock symbol. Higher stakes also raise the Lucky Wheel’s top prize tiers.
Feature Unlocks by Bet Level
SCATTER lands only on reel 4 and launches the Lucky Wheel.
Lucky Wheel Bonus = total bet × the multiplier landed on the wheel.
Payout = number-symbol combination + Lucky Wheel Bonus.
Respin
The RESPIN symbol appears only on reel 4. Landing it re-spins reels 1, 2 and 3.
Payout = number-symbol combination + the combination produced by the respin.

slide2: In the stygian dark of night, the forests of New England stir as a colossal behemoth—muttering, trembling, squirming with an unholy life of its own.
And within the maw of this dread leviathan, unhallowed flames flicker and wild, discordant drums pound, weaving a sonata of madness and chaos unbound.

The acolytes of a foul and forbidden cult dance and chant in rabid fervor, offering up living flesh as sacrifice, their hands outstretched to call forth those abhorrent entities whose very glance consigns mortal men to eternal lunacy or instant, annihilating oblivion: the Great Old Ones, who once ruled the cosmos for a trillion trillion years uncounted. ‌The Old Ones were, the Old Ones are, and the Old Ones shall be.
BACKGROUND STORY
Collect FEATURE
The Collect feature is triggered when a Collect Symbol appears any where on the reel.
Each Collect Symbol collects the values of all Cash and Jackpot Symbols currently on the reels.
Cash, Jackpot, and Collect Symbols do not appear in Call Of The Void.
slide3: Boost Bet – Activate to increase the chance of triggering the Bonus Games feature, at a cost of 1.5× the selected bet.
High-roller boost – Activate for approximately a 1 in 10.6 chance to reach the maximum win, at a cost of 2000× the selected bet.
Buy Bonus Game 1 – 4 Scatters award 12 spins in Call Of The Void or 3 spins in Rise Of R'lyeh, at a cost of 75× the selected bet.
Buy Bonus Game 2 – 5 Scatters award 20 spins in Call Of The Void or 5 spins in Rise Of R'lyeh, at a cost of 120× the selected bet.
Buy Bonus Game 3 – 6 Scatters award 30 spins in Call Of The Void or 7 spins in Rise Of R'lyeh, at a cost of 150× the selected bet.
